test_cases.title: collect.py scans unabsorbed retrospects by default
test_cases.description: Verify default scan lists only unabsorbed files, treats missing absorbed field as false
steps: Create test dir with 3 retrospect files: 1 absorbed, 1 unabsorbed, 1 without absorbed field
Run collect.py --root <test_dir>
Verify 2 files listed (unabsorbed + no-field), absorbed file excluded

test_cases.title: collect.py absorb updates YAML frontmatter
steps: Create test retrospect file with absorbed: false
Run collect.py --absorb <file> --summary 'test'
Read file and verify YAML: absorbed=true, absorbed_date=today, absorption_summary='test'

test_cases.title: collect.py aggregate deduplicates and sorts by frequency
test_cases.description: Verify --aggregate outputs deduplicated issues sorted by frequency
steps: Create test dir with 3 retrospect files sharing some harness_issues
Run collect.py --aggregate --root <test_dir>
Verify output shows deduplicated issues with correct frequency counts, sorted descending
